title: Milad Tower
summary: Milad Tower is a telecommunication tower in north-west Tehran, Iran, 435 m tall to the tip of its 120 m antenna mast. A concrete shaft carries a 12-storey head structure. A Canadian engineering firm lists its construction as 2001-2007.

uncertainty.note: Construction span per NCK; the lead's 2009 opening is given only by latlong.net and is not used.

where.historical_name: Milad Tower, Tehran, Islamic Republic of Iran

importance.justification: Tallest tower in Iran and a landmark telecommunication structure of Tehran.

sources.title: Seismic response analysis of Milad Tower in Tehran, Iran, under site-specific simulated ground motions
